moments.action: POV through a shattered windshield races past desert spectators; a bystander films from an SUV window, then the crowd scatters as a pale muscle car launches off the dirt and tumbles end over end.
Inside the rolling cars: the dark-haired driver braces hard against the roof, the second young man is thrown screaming against his belt, and the shot cuts out to the two wrecks grinding together.
The car settles upside down in the dust, wheels still turning. The camera drops under the roof to a body hanging inverted in its belt, then pushes to a face smeared with blood.
moments.censor_note: blood smeared across a forehead and eye in the final close-up, roughly a quarter of the frame

moments.action: Cut to a police station waiting area: the brown-haired teenager with tissue plugged in his nose, the blonde girl with a scraped face, and the blond athlete in a purple jersey sit apart while deputies work behind them.

Close-ups trade across the room: the athlete grins with blood filling his teeth, the blonde girl glances at him with contempt, and by the last pass she has turned her face down and away while he keeps smiling.
moments.censor_note: blood coating the teeth and lips in close-up, plus raw facial abrasions; roughly a fifth of the frame

moments.action: Grainy video of a red sports car at the construction site plays on a monitor; a detective in a striped shirt jabs at the screen, then turns from it to the brown-haired teenager sitting in the interview room.

The teenager sits cuffed-calm at the interview table with a deputy standing over him; the detective works the room, cutting once to the two others still waiting outside, and ends up planted over the boy's chair.
Tight shot/reverse: the detective leans in closer with each cut, voice rising, while the teenager's sidelong smirk hardens into a flat, worried stare by the last reverse.
The detective puts an arm around the boy and walks him out of the room, finger in his face, laying out terms; a uniformed deputy takes his shoulder and the boy looks back, cornered.
A red-haired woman storms in and swats at the teenager in front of the detective, then gets in his face shouting; he meets her eyes once, then drops his head and says nothing.
